recipes.name: Best Beer Cheese Soup
ingredients_raw: 2 (12 fluid ounce) cans or bottles domestic beer

steps.text: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown; drain on plate lined with paper towels; crumble.

Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot, and celery in the butter until soft, 7 to 10 minutes. Add the bacon, basil, oregano, and green onions; cook and stir 2 minutes. Stir the flour into the mixture until completely dissolved. Pour in the chicken broth and beer; cook until heated through. Melt the processed cheese food and Cheddar cheese in the mixture in small batches. Season with garlic powder and stir.

raw_recipe.headline: Best Beer Cheese Soup
raw_recipe.description: This delicious blend of cheese, bacon, onion, basil and more is easy to make and well worth the effort.

review.reviewBody: This was a delicious, quick meal! I had left over bacon already cooked, so that made it even easier. I didn't think it tasted too much like beer, but just right. Even my 2 and 4 year olds and even pickier husband liked it! I used 3 cups chicken broth and 1 can beer. next time, I will use both cans of beer. My husband took half of the soup and ran it thru the food processor and added some sour cream because he wanted it smooth and more creamy. Either way tasted pretty good. A quick tasty dinner. Will make this again for sure!

I followed the recipe but I sautéed the onions, carrots and celery in bacon grease. Then I added the beer and the broth to the sautéed vegetables and used my hand blender to mince the vegetables. I also added tbsp. of corn starch in addition to the flour. I added 1 cup of heavy cream and different shredded cheeses. Came out creamy and thick.

After reading the reviews I made a slight modification since I also like my cheese soup creamy. I added two cans of Campbell's cheddar cheese coup and simmered for about an hour. I then added the shredded cheddar in the last 10 minutes of cooking. I thought it turned out fine.
I found this recipe years ago after a cold wet soccer tournament. We add shredded smoked Gouda for a great flavor. I use a medium ipa.

I only used 1 bottle of beer, and I substituted vegetable broth for the chicken broth. I still thought that the flavor of the beer was a tad too strong, but I suggest that you adjust it to your taste. It was a good recipe for a chilly winter night, especially served with a thick crusty bread.
Very good! I added potatoes to it. I also did not use processed cheese. I added shredded marbled cheddar instead.

This is really good. The only reason why I rated it 4 stars is that there is too much beer in this recipe. I made it with one 12 ounce can of beer and 2 cans of chicken broth and still had a strong beer presence, not too much for my taste though, just about right. I would definitely make this again with those substitutions.

This was excellent! I used a light beer and used the full amount and it wasn't overpowering at all. I followed exactly except that I left the carrot out because I didn't have any. Will certainly make again!

I've been making this soup for a few years now, it's my go to octoberfest soup. It's super easy to make and doesn't take long. Sometimes I leave out the green onions as I don't feel they're necessary, but otherwise I follow the recipe exactly. I use an emulsifier to smooth out the chunks and get a creamier texture.
I used cheddar Jack cheese. Delicious.

I made this last Christmas Eve as I wanted to start a new tradition in our house and our friends are already talking about this year's feast, with the main dish as the soup :) It was excellent. Came out perfectly for me by following directions exactly. Can't wait to make it again this year!!
Maybe I used the wrong kind of beer (I don't drink beer), but the flavor was so strong! I couldn't even finish a bowl, but I'm giving it 3 stars because maybe I just don't like the taste of beer.

We didn't really like this. It was really runny, and I expected a lot thicker. Also, the flavor was off, though that could be partially because of the beer we used. I will be trying out a new recipe next time, however.
The flavor of this soup was great, but I expected it to be a little thicker.
Excellant soup!! Deleted the carrots and added kielbasa but other than that followed the recipe exactly. Was just was I was looking for on a rainy chilly New England night!!! Yums!!
i must have done something wrong
Excellent!! My boyfriend said this was the best homemade soup he has ever tasted! Can't wait to make it again!
